title: Cybersecurity
description: Web cybersecurity covering OWASP Top 10, SQL injection prevention, XSS/CSRF mitigation, authentication security, API security, and secure coding practices.
learning_outcomes: Understand cybersecurity fundamentals and threat landscape
Identify and prevent OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities

Protect APIs with rate limiting and authentication
